caveat: in-process-fixtures is not a measurement: tests/test_probes_fire.py asserts detected == planted on exactly those twelve environments, so a loss above zero there is a failing build. And external-envs is n=2, which is not a measurement either -- it is the honest size of the third-party control this corpus currently has.
